_note: The in-file/out-of-file lookup for a mixed-plural member must strip the member's OWN sub-pinpoint ('(a)'/'(b)') before checking host_section_numbers — '6502(a)' is section 6502's own sub-pinpoint, not a different section number; comparing the UNSTRIPPED string found no match and wrongly classified 6502(a) EXTERNAL. 6502(a) is INTERNAL (6502 is a host section); 45(b) is EXTERNAL (45 is not).
